items.title: Captain's Log
items.notes:
In 2026-08-02, I came up with a project's projected timeline (see: 20003891-9bba-4ed4-be2c-1db870fc0bf6,) but on 2026-08-07 I had the insight to interpret it as a "Captain's Log."  -- Which I think is a superior, much more useful idea!, at least initially.

Right now, I use snapshots on the Whiteboard as the Captain's Log, but -- I think it would serve much more utility outside the Whiteboard.

This might go in its own tab.
Perhaps the Dictionary might move into that tab as well.
